title: Web Server Fingerprinted: nginx 1.24.0 on Ubuntu Linux
description: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) serving the site at 76.13.46.223. HTTP redirects to HTTPS via 301.
risks: Known nginx vulnerabilities could be exploited if patches are missing.
attack_vectors: Research CVEs for nginx 1.24.0; probe for misconfigurations, default files, or version-specific exploits.
proof_of_existence: whatweb: HTTPServer[Ubuntu Linux][nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu)] IP[76.13.46.223] Title[Cyberian Defenses | Cybersecurity Advisory — MENA & Africa]
remediation: Keep nginx patched and up-to-date; hide server version header.

title: No DNSSEC — Domain Vulnerable to DNS Spoofing
description: WHOIS shows DNSSEC: unsigned. No DNSSEC records found. Domain traffic can be redirected via DNS cache poisoning.
risks: Attackers could redirect users to malicious sites via DNS spoofing, enabling credential theft.
attack_vectors: Perform DNS cache poisoning or man-in-the-middle to alter DNS responses for the domain.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing on the domain via registrar.

title: No CAA Records — Any Certificate Authority Can Issue Certificates
description: No CAA records found. Any CA can issue TLS certificates for this domain without restriction.
risks: Compromised or rogue CA could issue fraudulent certificates enabling MITM attacks.
attack_vectors: Request a TLS certificate from any CA for this domain; no DNS-level restriction prevents issuance.
proof_of_existence: dig CAA cyberian-defenses.com returned 0 answers, only SOA in AUTHORITY section.
remediation: Add CAA records restricting certificate issuance to specific CAs.

title: SPF Soft Fail (~all) — Email Spoofing Not Fully Prevented
description: SPF TXT record uses ~all (soft fail) instead of -all (hard fail). Spoofed emails may still be delivered to spam rather than rejected.
risks: Attackers can spoof emails from this domain; soft fail means recipients may still receive them.
attack_vectors: Send spoofed emails from unauthorized servers; SPF soft fail may allow delivery to spam/junk folders.
proof_of_existence: dig TXT: cyberian-defenses.com. 300 IN TXT "v=spf1 include:zohomail.com ~all"
remediation: Change SPF to -all (hard fail) and add DMARC with reject/quarantine policy.

title: Developer Email and Author Name Exposed in Page Metadata
description: Page source exposes email ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com and meta author 'Ahmed Chiboub'. Useful for phishing and OSINT.
risks: Email can be used for targeted phishing, social engineering, or credential stuffing attacks.
attack_vectors: Use email for spear-phishing campaigns; search for exposed accounts tied to ahmed.chiboub on social media/breaches.
remediation: Remove email and author metadata from HTML source.

title: Email Infrastructure Hosted on Zoho — Third-Party Attack Surface
description: MX records point to Zoho mail servers (mx.zoho.com, mx2.zoho.com, mx3.zoho.com). Email infrastructure is outsourced to Zoho.
risks: Compromise of Zoho account could lead to email takeover and phishing from legitimate domain.
attack_vectors: Target Zoho account credentials via phishing or credential stuffing; attempt Zoho admin panel access.
proof_of_existence: MX: 10 mx.zoho.com, 20 mx2.zoho.com, 50 mx3.zoho.com — all Zoho hosted.
remediation: Enable MFA on Zoho accounts; monitor for unauthorized access.

title: Subdomain Enumeration Incomplete — crt.sh Unavailable
description: crt.sh returned 502 Bad Gateway. Subdomain discovery via certificate transparency logs could not be completed.
risks: Hidden subdomains may exist that are not yet discovered, expanding attack surface.
attack_vectors: Retry crt.sh later; use alternative tools (subfinder, amass, SecurityTrails) for subdomain enumeration.
proof_of_existence: crt.sh returned: 502 Bad Gateway (nginx). No JSON data returned.
remediation: Re-run subdomain enumeration using alternative sources.

title: No IPv6 Support — No AAAA Record
description: No AAAA record exists. The domain is IPv4-only at 76.13.46.223. No IPv6 attack surface to probe.
risks: No IPv6 surface, but also no IPv6 security controls in place if added later.
attack_vectors: N/A — no IPv6 attack surface currently.
proof_of_existence: dig AAAA returned 0 answers, SOA in AUTHORITY section only.
remediation: Plan IPv6 adoption with proper security controls.

title: Strong Security Headers Detected on HTTPS
description: HSTS (max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload), X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN, X-XSS-Protection 1; mode=block, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all present.
risks: Low risk — headers are well-configured, reducing common web attack vectors.
attack_vectors: Limited client-side attacks due to strong headers; focus on server-side vulnerabilities.
proof_of_existence: HSTS[max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload] X-Frame-Options[SAMEORIGIN] X-XSS-Protection[1; mode=block] UncommonHeaders[x-content-type-options,referrer-policy,permissions-policy,content-security-policy]

title: Single IP Address — No CDN or WAF Detected
description: Domain resolves directly to 76.13.46.223 with no CDN or WAF in front. Server is directly exposed to the internet.
risks: No DDoS protection or WAF filtering; server directly exposed to attacks.
attack_vectors: Direct port scanning, DDoS, and exploitation of server-side vulnerabilities without WAF filtering.
proof_of_existence: A record: 76.13.46.223. whatweb confirms direct connection, no CDN headers (no Cloudflare, no Akamai).
remediation: Consider placing server behind CDN/WAF (Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront).

title: www.cyberian-defenses.com resolves to direct IP 76.13.46.223
description: www subdomain resolves directly to 76.13.46.223, no CDN/WAF in front. Direct server exposure.
risks: No WAF/CDN protection exposes server to direct attacks.
attack_vectors: Port scan 76.13.46.223, service fingerprinting, direct exploitation bypassing any edge filtering.
proof_of_existence: www.cyberian-defenses.com has address 76.13.46.223 (confirmed via host command and HackerTarget hostsearch API).
remediation: Place origin server behind WAF/CDN (Cloudflare, AWS WAF).

title: mail.cyberian-defenses.com uses Zoho Business email hosting
description: mail.cyberian-defenses.com is CNAME to business.zoho.com (204.141.42.199). Email hosted on Zoho Business.
risks: Zoho account compromise could lead to email takeover and phishing.
attack_vectors: Credential stuffing Zoho portal, password spray, phishing Zoho login page for ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com.
proof_of_existence: mail.cyberian-defenses.com is an alias for business.zoho.com. business.zoho.com has address 204.141.42.199
remediation: Enforce MFA on Zoho Business accounts, monitor login anomalies.

title: crt.sh CT log search unavailable (502 Bad Gateway)
description: crt.sh returned 502 Bad Gateway. CertSpotter API v1 discontinued. CT-based subdomain enumeration failed.
risks: Subdomain enumeration incomplete; hidden subdomains may exist but undetected.
attack_vectors: If subdomains exist with valid certs, they could host staging/dev/admin panels accessible to attackers.
proof_of_existence: crt.sh returned <title>502 Bad Gateway</title>. CertSpotter: 'API endpoint has been discontinued.'
remediation: Retry crt.sh later; use subfinder, amass, or Censys for CT log enumeration.

title: DNS zone transfer (AXFR) blocked by mission scope restrictions
description: AXFR attempts to ns1/ns2/ns3.systemdns.com were blocked — nameservers not in mission scope. Zone transfer status unknown.
risks: If AXFR is allowed on nameservers, full DNS zone could leak all subdomains and internal records.
attack_vectors: Test AXFR from an allowed IP or with proper scope authorization against systemdns.com nameservers.
proof_of_existence: BLOCKED: TARGET OUT OF SCOPE: hostname 'ns1.systemdns.com' is not within mission scope.
remediation: Request scope expansion for nameservers or test AXFR from authorized network.

title: Minimal subdomain footprint — 80+ brute-forced, only www and mail exist
description: Brute-forced 80+ common subdomains (dev, staging, api, admin, vpn, git, jenkins, etc.). All NXDOMAIN except www and mail.
risks: Limited attack surface is good but may miss non-standard subdomain names not in brute list.
attack_vectors: Try more creative subdomain names, use permutation tools, or passive DNS sources (SecurityTrails, Censys).
